Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

prefer — to like one thing more than another. Example: I prefer tea to coffee.
like — to enjoy something. Example: I like the red one better.
better — of higher quality than another. Example: I like the red one better.
favorite — the one you like most. Example: My favorite drink is tea.
choice — the act of choosing. Example: It is a difficult choice.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I prefer ... to ...
• I like ... better.
• My favourite is ...
• It is a difficult choice.
• Which do you prefer?
